title: Formulating Discrete Probability Flow Through Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: 共线数据下连续PF有限区间是Monge映射；ReLU单向流生成元定义离散probability flow，CIFAR-10 CSD 57.7→9.4
tldr_en: Continuous PF is a Monge map on finite intervals for collinear data; a one-directional ReLU generator defines discrete probability flow, cutting CIFAR-10 CSD from 57.7 to 9.4.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 (tauLDR-0 pretrained, 1000 init x 10 samples): CSD 57.6898 -> 9.4420; class-std 2.6628 -> 1.1819; class-entropy 1.7703 -> 0.5291 (Table 8)
Synthetic (32 dims, 2 states): CSD SDDM 14.05-14.74 vs DPF 1.72-2.18 (Table 2); MMD SDDM 2.18e-6 vs DPF 1.89e-5 on 2spirals (Table 1)
Prop. 2/4: PF map is Monge OT on any finite interval when all data points are collinear
